name: cinderbox
description: Disposable email addresses on your own domain, delivered to Discord, Telegram, or Slack. Runs on Cloudflare Workers with Email Routing and D1, or on mail.tm with no domain at all.

DISPOSABLE_DOMAIN.description: A domain you own, already added to this Cloudflare account. Leave blank to run on mail.tm's domain instead, which needs no domain or DNS.

DISCORD_TOKEN.description: Bot token, from the Bot tab of your Discord application

DISCORD_PUBLIC_KEY.description: Public Key, from the General Information tab

DISCORD_APPLICATION_ID.description: Application ID, from the General Information tab

MAX_ACTIVE_ADDRESSES.description: Optional. How many addresses one person can hold at once. Defaults to 5.
